sentences.9.3 Hvor lenge har du bodd her?: 9.3 How long have you lived here?
sentences.Marek har flyttet inn i ny leilighet i e: Marek has moved into a new apartment in a block of flats.
sentences.I dag treffer han en gammel mann i oppga: Today he meets an old man in the stairwell, and the old man starts talking to Marek.
sentences.God dag! Har du nettopp flyttet inn? Jeg: Good afternoon! Have you just moved in? I haven't seen you before.
sentences.Jeg har bodd her i to uker. Kona og jeg: I've lived here for two weeks. My wife and I moved in two weeks ago. My name is Marek. We live on the fifth floor.
sentences.Velkommen hit! Jeg heter Gustav og bor i: Welcome! My name is Gustav, and I live in the apartment below you. My wife and I have lived here for 30 years.
sentences.Ja, vi trives så godt her. Vi har mange: Yes, we're very happy here. We have lots of good neighbours. What do you do?
sentences.Jeg er snekker, og kona mi leter etter j: I'm a carpenter, and my wife is looking for a job now. She learned a little Norwegian in Poland, but she has to learn more Norwegian first. What do you do?
sentences.Jeg arbeidet som lege i 40 år, og kona m: I worked as a doctor for 40 years, and my wife was a lawyer, but now we have retired. The children moved out many years ago, but we often talk to the nice neighbours.
sentences.Jeg har ikke truffet mange naboer. Jeg h: I haven't met many neighbours. I've only said hello to the young neighbours next door to us. They are nice.
sentences.Jeg håper dere vil trives her. Dere må h: I hope you will be happy here. You must remember the dugnad on Saturday. I have taken part in all the dugnads here. After the dugnad we drink coffee and eat waffles, and there are hot dogs and ice cream for the children. You can get to know the neighbours at the dugnad.
sentences.Tusen takk, det skal jeg huske. Hyggelig: Thank you very much, I'll remember that. Nice to meet you. See you on Saturday.
sentences.Det gjør vi. Ha en fin dag!: We will. Have a nice day!
I have got to know a Norwegian neighbour.
sentences.For to uker siden flyttet Marek inn i de: Two weeks ago Marek moved into the new apartment.
sentences.I dag treffer han en norsk nabo i oppgan: Today he meets a Norwegian neighbour in the stairwell.
sentences.Naboen heter Gustav, og han og kona har: The neighbour's name is Gustav, and he and his wife have lived there for 30 years.
Marek and Ewa live above Gustav.
sentences.Gustav og kona har barn, men barna flytt: Gustav and his wife have children, but the children moved out many years ago.
Gustav was a doctor for many years.
Gustav tells him about the dugnad on Saturday.
sentences.Marek blir glad for å møte en hyggelig n: Marek is glad to meet a nice neighbour.
